idea: Animals & their sounds #2 (THE ZOO, low wooden fence): a cute baby elephant pops its head up over the zoo fence right beside Baby Ava's face, curly trunk up ('Wow! Look! A baby elephant!'); chorus 'Animal sounds! Sing with me!'; 'The elephant says toot, toot, toot!'; a little monkey on the fence rail – 'Ooh ooh, ah ah!'; a lion cub does a tiny cute roar – 'Roar, roar, roar!'; copy-me 'Scratch your head! Ooh ooh, ah ah!'; she asks the viewer 'Who says toot, toot? Hmm?' (pause) – 'The elephant! Toot, toot! Yay!'; lesson 'Animal sounds at the zoo!'. Loop: the hook framing again, now elephant, monkey and lion cub together, bye-bye wave.
title: Wow! A Baby Elephant! 🐘 Zoo Animal Sounds with Baby Ava | Learn Animals | Crayon Babies
description:
Wow! A baby elephant pops up at the zoo – toot, toot! 🐘 Sing along with Baby Ava and learn the sounds of three zoo animals: the elephant, the monkey and the lion.

🎬 What happens in this video:
😮 "Wow! Look! A baby elephant!" – a surprise at the zoo fence
🐘 The elephant says toot, toot, toot!
🐒 A little monkey! Ooh ooh, ah ah!
🦁 A little lion! Roar, roar, roar!
🙌 Scratch your head with Ava: ooh ooh, ah ah!
🤔 "Who says toot, toot?" – can you answer?
👋 The elephant! Bye bye, friends!

📚 Kids learn: zoo animals and their sounds • elephant – toot • monkey – ooh ooh, ah ah • lion – roar

🎶 Voices only: children singing, humming and clapping with a soft hand drum – no other musical instruments.

A fun sing-along animal sounds song for toddlers and preschoolers, with Baby Ava meeting a baby elephant, a little monkey and a lion cub at a sunny zoo.
